response.overview: Frank Castle (Thomas Jane) needs to do his laundry. To avoid drawing attention to himself, he heads to a run-down, terrorized neighborhood. On his way to the laundromat, he witnesses Goldtooth’s (Sammi Rotibi) gang assaulting a group of prostitutes. Not wanting to blow his cover, he decides not to get involved. However, when the criminals begin tormenting a young boy, the Punisher decides to mete out justice in his own signature style.
response.title: The Punisher: Dirty Laundry
